title: SAKIKO
description: A Japanese school after dark. Explore the empty halls, piece together the evidence, and find a way out.
features: First-person exploration, object inspection and a journal.
Connected classroom routes and a hand-operated shutter.
Eight task checkpoints retain completed tasks when retrying.

title: Jellink
description: Drop, link, and pop soft-body jellies. A custom physics puzzle made for one-thumb play.
features: Custom collision and pressure-driven jelly deformation.
Native Android drawing and audio; no WebView.
Offline solo, optional Versus and shared-jar Co-op.

title: MauCuan
description: An Indonesian money tracker with receipt scanning, savings goals, and Miko, a virtual companion.
features: On-device receipt reading with review before saving.
Transactions, savings goals and an Android widget.
A virtual companion connected to daily habits.

title: Shoot a Boss
description: An office worker’s notebook dream becomes a first-person campaign against paperwork monsters.
alt: Shoot a Boss — actual project screenshot
features: Twelve-stage campaign and five map themes.
Weapons, cards, magic and persistent progression.
Hand-drawn visual language with desktop and touch controls.

title: Wildfeast: Isles of Wonder
description: Explore a strange food world, bring ingredients home, and run a small restaurant.
alt: Wildfeast: Isles of Wonder — actual project screenshot
features: A loop connecting exploration, gathering, cooking and serving.
Playable fishing, farming, cooking and restaurant service.
Art, maps and creatures remain in development.

title: Rundori Receipt Web
description: Order management and private digital receipts for a shoe-care studio.
alt: Rundori Receipt Web — actual project screenshot
features: Staff allowlist and server-side authorization.
Expiring, revocable customer receipt links.
Private before/after photos delivered with signed URLs.

title: Lantern Lot
description: An offline secondhand-shop game prototype. Inspect auction lots, bid, appraise objects, stock shelves and negotiate with customers.
features: One authored household-clearance fixture with auctions and shop sales.
Transactional local saves with recovery snapshots.
Early prototype; production art and Android export remain planned.

title: BNCC Feedback
description: A small CRUD application for collecting internal event feedback, with a feedback form and an administration panel.
features: Create, read, update and delete feedback.
In-memory storage resets when the server restarts.
Prototype admin panel has no login.

title: Jakarta Flood AI Prediction
description: An educational browser-based flood-risk prototype using rainfall, sea level and elevation inputs. Developed with Jason Nathaniel Prijatno and Marco Sukandar.
features: Neural network trained in-browser using synthetic data.
Displays an estimated risk category and chart.
Educational demonstration, not a validated flood forecast.

title: MEDISSL Portfolio
description: A personal portfolio bringing software, games and artwork into a first-person crystal mine, with a direct project index and a Supabase-backed publishing workflow.
features: Keyboard and touch-controlled railway discoveries.
Project inspection and lightweight browsing.
Existing artwork publishing and admin workflows.
